newsitem.title: UK: UK Tories call fishing vote "outstanding success".
newsitem.headline: UK Tories call fishing vote "outstanding success".

text.p: Conservative Party chairman Brian Mawhinney on Tuesday hailed as "an outstanding success" the government's two parliamentary wins over European fishing policy.

But the opposition Labour Party accused the Conservatives of "back-room manoeuvring" after the government won, by 11 and 12 votes, the first big test for Prime Minister John Major since he lost his parliamentary majority last week.

Conservative Party chairman Dr Brian Mawhinney said: "This is a resounding success with the vote in double figures. We have listened to the representations from the fishermen's leaders and we will continue to fight their corner."
A Labour spokesman claimed that there had been "backroom manoeuvring" prior to the vote.
He said: "This is a government that is living from day to day and deal to deal."
